timing: Registered after locking A and starting the heldout runner, before inspecting any heldout outcome for old or A. The baseline431 count alone was visible. This gate was not in the initial A/B/C study plan.
rule: Evaluate only the locked A candidate. Publish its paired NPZ/PT as the new deployment model only if completed heldout aggregate success_count is at least the frozen old model count and no numerical failures occur. Otherwise keep the existing deployment model. Do not train further, evaluate B/C on heldout, or select another newly trained checkpoint.
purpose: Respect the user requirement to retain the best established deployment model; distinguish release acceptance from the earlier development selection.
